turns.text: Make a square book-swap poster. Black lettering only, no pictures. The text should be exactly 'BOOK SWAP', 'Saturday 10-2' and 'Maple Hall'. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Nothing has run, and no credits have been spent.

**The cheapest option is a text-only SVG poster: 0 Magic Hour credits.** It can be square, with black lettering on white and exactly:
- BOOK SWAP
- Saturday 10-2
- Maple Hall

SVG keeps the lettering exact and stays sharp at any size—no AI generation needed.

**Magic Hour’s lowest listed image price is 5 credits** for one 640 × 640 image using the free-plan-compatible Flux 2 Klein model. Smaller output won’t lower that listed minimum; “shorter” doesn’t apply to a still poster. AI-generated lettering may also need correction.

Would you prefer the **free SVG code you can save as a poster**, or the **5-credit AI image**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the free SVG poster.

turns.agent:
Here’s the **free SVG poster—0 credits used**. Save this code as `book-swap.svg`, then open it in a browser to view or print.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="640" height="640" viewBox="0 0 640 640">
  <rect width="640" height="640" fill="white"/>
  <g fill="black"
     font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
     text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="320" y="275"
          font-size="76" font-weight="900"
          letter-spacing="-2">BOOK SWAP</text>
    <text x="320" y="355"
          font-size="38" font-weight="400">Saturday 10-2</text>
    <text x="320" y="415"
          font-size="30" font-weight="400">Maple Hall</text>
  </g>
</svg>
```
